comments: Riven, The Exile — Build B "anti-engine" (Kennen, mirror), from Jeremy's
"Competitive Riven" study, section 8: the 31-card core with the bounce row
replacing the core's Rebuke / Star-Crossed, 2 Scuttle Crab + 2 Evelynn,
1 Blitzcrank + 1 Vex, 1 Battle Preparations + 1 An Offer You Can't Refuse.
Runes 6/6 (one Rebuke only, per the study's rune note).
Sideboard (not used by the simulator): 2 Decree of Focus, 1 An Offer You Can't Refuse,
Riven, The Exile — Nam Dang, 1st of 755, Riftbound Showdown 25k LDXP Sacramento (2026-10-24).
Source: the reference list in Jeremy's "Competitive Riven" study (RiftDecks list
riven-the-exile-338917), cross-checked against OpenRift / Runes and Rift summaries.
Known discrepancy between sites: Tideturner 2 vs 3, Rebuke and Switcheroo counts.
The RiftDecks page itself could not be fetched from this environment.
